description: Run a failed task again, a command or claude-code task included, as attempt 1 of a new count. Use when: a task failed and should run again. Do not use for a task that did not fail (use expedite_task or update_deadline). Behavior: with the provider's key in the server env, one call now; its result and signed receipt replace the old ones. A command or claude-code task, or one with no key here, is due now and the next tidegap tick runs it. The deadline does not block it. Returns: status (completed, failed, retrying or scheduled), error on failure. Rejects non-failed, unknown and job-run tasks.

task_id.description: Id of the failed task to run again, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the check_queue_status list (status failed).

name: retry_task
